newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan buys 30,000 tonnes of sugar - trade.
newsitem.headline: Jordan buys 30,000 tonnes of sugar - trade.

text.p: Jordan bought 30,000 tonnes of sugar in two lots for shipment starting in mid-November, traders said on Wednesday.
One lot of 15,000 tonnes is for shipment in the second half of November and was bought at $367 per tonne C&F.
The rest is for shipment in the first half of December and was bought at $360.50 C&F.
Jordan's ministry of supply made the purchase from Paris-based Dreyfus, they added.
Jordan's average annual consumption is estimated at 180-190,000 tonnes.
